description: Landlords screen on credit file and local references. A new arrival has neither, so the options are a large deposit, a guarantor, or the informal market.
money_note: Additional deposit, agency fees, guarantor services.

description: Iran has reciprocal exchange arrangements with few destination countries, so most Iranians must re-sit theory and practical tests, often with a waiting list, and pay higher insurance as a 'new' driver despite decades of experience.
notes: Reciprocity lists are published per jurisdiction - verify per country. Layer-5 target.

aspect: Insurance priced on a blank history
description: No local claims history means the highest premium band for several years, regardless of actual record.

aspect: Children re-placed by language, not ability
description: Children are commonly placed by language proficiency rather than academic level, losing a year or more and the peer group with it.
energy_note: A child demoted for an accent.

description: Iranian social insurance contributions are not portable to any major destination, so working years already paid for are simply lost.
notes: No totalisation agreement located between Iran and major destinations. Layer-5 target: confirm per country.
